name: – Commission proposal
title: The protection status of the wolf (Canis lupus) ***I
part_text:
The European Commission asks the Council to approve the European Union's position in a group of countries that sets rules for government-backed loans for buying civil aircraft. That group is adding rules for loans covering aircraft maintenance, services, spare parts and engine kits. The Commission wants the Union to support these new rules. The aim is to make the rules clearer and fairer between the countries in the group. The report gives no figures beyond the changes listed below.

- Repayment periods can be longer for deals above a set contract value.
- The minimum down payment drops from 30% to 15% of the export contract value.
- The start of the credit period is adjusted to fit service contracts; the Union position is then adopted.
